title: Reunited Worlds [Hindi]
description: Sung Hae Sung (Yeo Jin Goo, Circle: Two Worlds Connected) is a cheery high school student. Being the eldest sibling, he wants to provide for his family instead of going to college. On the day of his 19th birthday, he gets into a car accident and passes out. He wakes up on the top of his school building. He thinks he survived and everything is normal. Except everyone thinks he died 12 years ago, and he hasn't aged at all. Jung Jung Won (Lee Yeon Hee, The Package) is Hae Sung's best friend. She was the one who took him to the place where he had his accident. Distraught, she has been unable to move on from the incident since. Having failed to pursue her dreams under the stress, she works as a kitchen assistant at a nice restaurant. Cha Min Joon (Ahn Jae Hyun, Cinderella and Four Knights) is the owner of the restaurant where Jung Won works. He has feelings for her. However, she has never shown any interest in him. In her mind, she can't be with anyone while carrying Hae Sung in her memories. One night, Jung Won finds a young man passed out in front of her house. He is Hae Sung, her first love. She is now 31; he is 19. Can they pick up their love where they left off, or will their reunited worlds always stay separate? Also known as "Into the World Again" and "Into the New World," Reunited Worlds is directed by Baek Soo Chan and written by Lee Hee Myung, the creative team behind Beautiful Gong Shim and Sensory Couple.

title: Crystal's Greatest Creation
description:
This story is a compelling exploration of hidden identities, love, and self-worth set against the backdrop of wealth and ambition. It challenges the idea of whether love can survive without truth and equality. The narrative follows two individuals who reject their powerful identities, only to rediscover themselves through each other.
Blending romance, drama, and high-stakes business conflict, the show presents a layered world of deception, family politics, and emotional transformation. At its core, it is a story of a woman’s journey from being an unseen force behind success to owning her power unapologetically.
With themes of betrayal, reinvention, and partnership, the show balances mass appeal with a modern, aspirational tone.

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN [Hindi]
description:
A boy fights... for "the right death."

Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.

Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with the Double-Faced Specter. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojou Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo Metropolitan Technical High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode received an early web premiere on September 19th, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 3rd, 2020.

🧡 ■ "eFootball™" - An Evolution from "PES"
It's an all-new era of digital soccer: "PES" has now evolved into "eFootball™"! And now you can experience the next generation of soccer gaming with "eFootball™"!

■ Welcoming Newcomers
After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!

[Ways of Playing]
■ Build Your Very Own Dream Team
You have a plethora of teams that can be chosen as your Base Team, including European and South American powerhouses, J.League and national teams!

■ Sign Players
After creating your team, it's time to get some signings in! From current superstars to soccer legends, sign players and take your team to new heights!

・ Special Player List
Here you can sign special players such as standouts from actual fixtures, players from featured leagues, and legends of the game!

・ Standard Player List
Here you can handpick and sign your favorite players. You can also use the Sort and Filter functions to narrow your search.

■ Playing Matches
Once you have built a team with your favorite players, it's time to take them to the field.
From testing your skills against the AI, to competing for ranking in Online Matches, enjoy eFootball™ the way you like!

・ Sharpen your skills in VS AI Matches
There are a variety of Events that coincide with the real-world soccer calendar, including a "Starter" Event for those just starting out, as well as Events where you can play against teams from high-profile leagues. Build a Dream Team that fits the Events' themes and take part!

・ Put your strength to the test in User Matches
Enjoy real-time competition with the Division-based "eFootball™ League" and a wide variety of weekly Events. Can you take your Dream Team to the pinnacle of Division 1?

・ Max 3 vs 3 matches with friends
Use the Friend Match feature to play against your friends. Show them the true colors of your well-developed team!
Cooperative matches up to 3 vs 3 are also available. Get together with your friends and enjoy some heated soccer action!

■ Player Development
Depending on Player Types, signed players can be further developed.
Level up your players by having them play in matches and by using in-game items, then utilize the acquired Progression Points to develop them to match your playing style.

title: A Sense of a Maze
description: In this allegorical documentary we exercise a search for answers to life's unpronounced questions in the labyrinth of a medieval medina. The milestones of the quest are existential, scientific, religious and artistic expressions. Here colors, sounds, figures and authentic musical threads lead the wanderer. The verbal, as well as the visual and sonic guidance concerns eternal truth-seeking, fear, foreignness, the sacredness of life, the discovery of "otherness", the loss of the garden of Eden, inside and outside, work and worship, ecstasy and pacification.

title: Pwede G, pwede B
description: Basil, a 30-year-old womanizer, has his life turned upside down when he wakes up from a night of drunken sex with his straight best friend, Theo, who is about to be married. Suddenly, every time he tries to hook up with a woman, a man magically appears to have sex with him instead.

title: Like a B1
description: A truly Franco-Korean short film about languages, about a Korean girl passing the French oral exam test in a peculiar way. Made in Korea by a French director with a mixed French and Korean team, sponsored by the Korean 'Alliance Française' and also financed by a wide crowdfunding campaign.

title: Urlau(b)
description: For a long time, the village of Urlau at the foot of the Allgäu Alps was only known for its ammunition arsenal. Cäcilia Angerer still remembers the looming catastrophe during World War II. But lately Urlau has been sprucing itself up because a huge resort is about to be built where toxic warfare ammunition was once stored. Christian Skrodzki has been planning a community project to give an old factory building in the village a new purpose. The Wehr family has been preparing their vacation apartment for rent. Things are going well for the region, but suddenly it is proclaimed: "Stay home!"

title: B'T X
description: The story follows Teppei, a caretaker of a farm located in Kamui Island. He visits his genius brother who studies robotics in Germany only to see him get abducted by a group of half human half machine beings. Using a powerful weapon he calls the Meisei Fist, he attempts to hunt them down and rescue his brother.

title: Laila B.
description: Since surviving a physical assault on the steps of her South Boston apartment, Laila Bataglia (30) has been keeping a low profile. She spends her days hiding behind her social media persona and struggles to make ends meet as a freelance writer and part-time bartender at The Clock Tower, where she works with her ever-supportive best friend, Patrice. When a young woman turns up dead in her neighborhood, Laila is forced to face her fears again, revealing that her real fight is far from over. Inspired by true events and melding narrative with cinema verite, LAILA B. is writer, director, actor Amy DePaola's meditation on reclaiming one's power in an uncontrollable modern world.

title: Jae-seok's B&B Rules!
description: Yu Jae-seok ventures into running a B&B alongside Lee Kwang-soo, Byeon Woo-seok, and Ji Ye-eun. The staff and guests create memorable moments filled with laughter and genuine connections.

title: Lady B.
description: Venice, July 1909. A boy from south of Italy, just rejected from the Naval Academy because of thoracic insufficiency and a slight squint, unexpectedly rescues a British pretty widow's life, Lady B. The two are joined only by a hopeless vitality and an unconsciousness desire. The lady will decide to spend with that boy a whole week of passion in which she'll teach him everything about dancing and seducing. That boy will become, in few years, the greatest mute film icon: Rudolph Valentino.

title: Plan B

title: There is No Plan B

title: B2: Stealth at War
description: The most expensive and specialized airplane ever built, the B2 Stealth bomber carries a price tag of more than two billion dollars. Highly effective and extremely technically advanced, it has been an integral part of the Air Force arsenal for the past 20 years. From a Cold War scrap heap candidate, to the go-to bomber in the 2011 strike against Qaddafi's army in Libya, "Spirit" has seen its share of trials and triumphs. Join us as we detail how this secret weapon evolved to overcome critics, espionage, and even tragedy, to change the shape of aviation forever.

title: Affinity
description: In 2051, bioengineering student Wu Nongyu and sociopath Xie Xinxu are drawn together by a mysterious genetic attraction. As their relationship grows, they must confront their pasts and navigate love, trust, and redemption while racing to find a way to break the powerful bond that threatens to control their lives.

title: C moi qui régale!
description: After a call for help sent by a child, a cooking coach (Benjamin Darnaud) arrives in a family: he helps with using the content of the fridge and kitchen cupboards, nutrition advice, preparation of meals and decoration of the dining table.

title: Rebirth
description: During the Battle at the Frozen Lake, both Zhuge Yue and Chu Qiao fell into the icy waters. Chu Qiao was rescued by Yan Xun, only to learn that Zhuge Yue had perished; she subsequently sought an opportunity to assassinate Yan Xun to avenge Zhuge Yue. While in Bian Tang, Chu Qiao received repeated assistance from a mysterious man, someone who felt strangely familiar, leading her to suspect that Zhuge Yue might still be alive. Meanwhile, Yan Xun's actions grew increasingly extreme, plunging the four kingdoms into chaos. Ultimately, will Chu Qiao be able to restore peace to the realm, guide Yan Xun back from his misguided path, and reuniting with Zhuge Yue, help secure a better homeland for the people?

title: C/O Sir
description: Jayabrata Ray, a teacher of a reputed school in Kurseong, finds himself in a helpless situation after losing his eyesight. Although the school authorities allow him to continue with his job for a while, but all hell breaks loose when he starts getting threat calls from the management asking him to vacate his property that is situated right inside the school premises. Jayabrata, who had also been a student of the same school, could see through their real intention and simply refuses to budge.

title: As Beautiful as You
description: Chronicles the ups and downs of Ji Xing as she navigates being an entrepreneur and falling in and out of love.

title: Till I See You
description: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: The C-Bazz Cast
description: The C-Bazz Cast show "Where we have a whole lot of fun just for you" The first episode kicks off with the crazy four (C-Bazz, K-Shan, Howard Hall and DJ GYMC) bringing the funny. Special in studio guest Brandon Abidin and Jennifer Abidin of Intelligent Mortgage.

title: Who Stole My AC in 40°C Heat?
description: Marco, an appliance dealer who rose from the bottom, returned to his old apartment building and paid out of his own pocket to install air conditioners for every household, as a way of repaying the kindness he had received years ago. However, his neighbor Marina took the lead in filing claims under various pretexts and engaging in moral blackmail. Without arguing, Marco dismantled all the air conditioners overnight and took them away. When the scorching heat arrived, the old building suffered terribly, while the new building across the street remained cool and orderly. After enduring heatstroke, shortages, and failed extortion attempts, the neighbors finally broke down and had no choice but to turn to Marco for help. Marco presented them with a business contract and insisted that things be done according to the rules. In the end, the neighbors paid to have the units reinstalled—except for Anna, the only one who had stayed clear-headed back then, and who received Marco's free, special care.

title: Princess Silver
description: Rong Le, a princess of the royal family of the Xiqi Kingdom who wakes up one day to find that she has lost her memory. She is ordered to marry Zong Zheng Wu You, seventh prince of the neighboring Beilin Kingdom, though her husband-to-be refuses to let her inside his manor. Unable to return home, Rong Le settles down in Beilin and opens a teahouse under the alias of Manyao. It is rumored that the Qin family has misplaced an extraordinary tome that will supposedly usher in a time of prosperity for all the kingdoms, and Manyao embarks on a journey to find the book. Manyao and Wu You meet and fall in love without realizing each other's true identity, though they are forced to separate when Rong Le's brother Rong Qi orders her to marry the powerful General Fu Chou.

title: The F Word
description: Robert Adanto's The F Word explores radical "4th wave" feminist performance through interviews with a new generation of feminist artists who use their bodies as subject matter. Because the female body continues to be politicized and policed, and because these artists delve into the fecund territory of female sexuality, self-objectification, and the female form as a site of resistance, many remain marginalized by the mainstream art world. Brooklyn-based Leah Schrager, well known for her performance practice, Naked Therapy, states, "As soon as you introduce a bit of sexiness or sexuality into an artwork it suddenly becomes questionable. Just because something elicits arousal or shows elements of sexiness does absolutely not make it not art." While some 4th wave artists, like Ann Hirsch and Kate Durbin, choose to analyze representations of female identity through digital media, others, like the radical, queer, transnational feminist art collective, Go! Push Pops, explore sexuality and gender in pop culture in the digital age. As feminist lecturer Kristen Sollee explains, 4th wavers, unlike their predecessors, "are not afraid to be 'girly', (or) to be hyper-feminine, or to wear a mini-skirt, to self-objectify" in the service of challenging patriarchal oppression or sexist ideals. Dr. Kathy Battista, Director of Contemporary Art at Sotheby's Institute of Art, New York and author of Re-negotiating the Body: Feminist Artists in 1970s London (IB Tauris, 2012), is an on-screen expert, as are noted art critic and curator, Nancy Princenthal, and feminist lecturer, Kristen Sollee.

title: Sa-rang-i i-gin-da
description: No pain, no gain. Then cracks appear in the facade which soon deepen and spread. In particular, the father seems to be losing control - he is suddenly faced with a sexual harassment lawsuit and an absurd running battle with a taxi driver.

title: I fichissimi
description: Mechanic Romeo and grocery deliverer Felice lead two rival gangs and the local discotheque is not big enough for the both of them. When Romeo falls for Felice's sister, conveniently called Giulietta, the entire town becomes too small for the two rivals. Romeo is adamant to keep on seeing Giulietta while keeping clear of Felice, while Felice is forcing other suitors onto his sister that are more to his liking.

title: And I Ride and I Ride
description: Musician and Kat Onoma band leader until 2004, Rodolphe Berger lives as if he had nine lives. He's had many determining if paradoxical meetings, with artists or fameless and workless characters, to the point of sabotaging himself sometimes. He kept on going no matter what, transfiguring rock music, mixing his own intimate story with some history of music, a story of people with a story of places. He kept going towards a destination he didn't necessarily want to know about. We only know where his home bases are: Sainte-Marie-aux-Mines, Paris, Batz Island. We only know that it all stems from something - that his personal path took him from philosophy to music.

title: K Chyornomu moryu
description: Pretty Irina Kruchinina learns her first year at a pedagogical university. The teacher of the same institute, Konstantin Aleksandrovich, is not indifferent to her and suggests to go in the summer together to the Black Sea on the new "Volga".

title: K.
description: A documentary about a less privileged boy whom at a young age started reaching out to street children who are less fortunate like him.

title: K.O. Beast
description: Set in the distant future in which the Earth is split in two. The southern hemisphere is placed in another dimension while the inhabitants of the northern hemisphere are able to morph into beast-like humanoids. Eventually the humans of the southern hemisphere, led by Uranus, attack the Beasts. The Three Beasts, Wan Derbard (Wan Dabadadatta) of the Tiger Tribe, Bud Mint (Baado Mint) of the Bird Tribe, and Mei Mer (Mei Mah) of the Mermaid Tribe, are taken prisoner along with Mei Mer's companion Tuttle Millen (Mekka Mannen, also of the Mermaid tribe), but manage to escape thanks to a little girl named Yuuni Charm Password. Together they seek Gaia, which they believe to be a fabulous treasure, but they are pursued by Uranus's minions : V-Darn the vicious mage-knight, V-Sion the warrior woman and Akumako, V-Darn's sadistic imp-like partner.

title: Chelovek K
description: The main character, which is a prototype of Kafka, is on his way to achieving true self-cognition. The impetus for this was vague childhood memories associated with emotions, as well as the identification of his identity with certain images at that period. He is facing an internal conflict, tearing him apart, between creativity and reality that are not compatible with each other.

title: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha
description: A big-city dentist opens up a practice in a close-knit seaside village, home to a charming jack-of-all-trades who is her polar opposite in every way.

title: Bilder (m)einer Mutter
description: A seemingly entirely normal childhood in the 80s, captured on countless video cassettes. On them a family in which each one plays their own role. But there's a shadow on everyday life. With his camera the father calmly documents how in between christmas celebrations and school events the mother becomes more and more of a shadow of herself. At first she disappears from the recordings, later on from the family all together. Father, brother and sister are left and the family construct crumbles. With her film the director callenges her family to break their decades-long silence concerning the loss of the mother. A diary is found, as well as the father's old super 8-recordings, in which the mother still smiled into the camera lovingly. We emerge into the life story of Gaby, who dreams of leaving the bavarian small town and her old school parents as a teenager. Despite the revolutionary cliché of the 70s, marriage is the only logical way to independence for the couple. The climate of the time, torn between emancipation and a conservative way of though, rubs off on the biography of the young woman. Images from society and politics show plenary chambers filled by men and planes with no female pilots in sight. Gabi struggles with the realization of her dreams while her husband lives out a successful career. The camera joins a woman on her tragic life's path, who ultimately stumbles over her role as mother, which she never fully took on.

title: O Debate
description: A chief editor of a newsroom and a TV host, who were married for a long time, must try to conciliate their personal distinct views while working together during the coverage of a political debate of great importance for the nation's future.

title: O filos mou o Lefterakis
description: Thodorakis is a womanizer who lies to his wife about having a friend who lives in Patra in order to cover his dirty business. What happens when this fake friend appears in front of him and the night before he is ready to go with his mistress?

title: O stohos
description: A journalist is investigating the severe conditions that result in polluting the atmosphere. He turns against wealthy and unscrupulous men who control the chemical factories. The most powerful of them happens to have an erotic relationship with our hero's ex-wife. One day while doing his TV-show concerning the environmental conditions, he dares to say the truth and soon he ends up imprisoned. When he is released, he does the same, until he pays the price.

title: Daddy O, Baby O
description:
Mario (Dolphy) has to fulfill a promise made to his dying friend- take on the role of a father to a very mischievous girl, Ana (Serena Dalrymple). Released in 2000 and directed by Eric Quizon.

title: O Rebelde e o Estudioso
description: Maya Hayes é uma aluna nota dez com um objetivo: estudar muito, escapar do pai violento e nunca mais olhar para trás. Mas ao buscar refúgio em um estúdio de tatuagem após uma surra, ela esbarra no rebelde do Colégio Oakridge, Jude Sinclair. Logo, a aluna exemplar e o garoto rico com um passado sombrio viram colegas de classe. As madrugadas viram segredos compartilhados, e os insultos dão lugar à compreensão. Aos poucos, enxergam além de suas armaduras e descobrem algo verdadeiro. Juntos, fazem um pacto: libertar-se, lutar e destruir tudo o que tenta derrubá-los.

title: O Paciente: O Caso Tancredo Neves
description: Revisits the final moments before the mysterious death of 1985 Brazilian president-to-be Tancredo Neves.

title: O grousouzis
description: A grumpy old man finds a baby on his doorstep and decides to adopt it, much to the amazement of the people in his neighborhood.

title: O-Parts
description: In the year 2141, Japan successfully builds a basic time machine that can send data to the past. However, an evil organization further develops the technology, making it possible to send objects back in time as well. The organization begins a plan to send 5 terrorists back to the year 2012 in order to assassinate the ancestor of an important person from their time. The future government, alerted to this fact, uses its time machine to notify the government of 2012 about the plot, telling them to recruit 5 people in order to seek out the terrorists.

title: O sexokynigos
description: Even though he tries to lead a temptation-free life in the rugged wilderness, a blind shepherd becomes the object of desire for the village's sexually frustrated women. Will they keep him blind forever? Above all, will he ever find love?

title: O Predileto
description: Based on the novel "Totônio Pacheco", written by João Alphonsus. At the time of the decadence of the great farms of Minas Gerais, Totônio is a symbol of the golden age of state farms: old and accustomed to having all his wills obeyed. However, after moving to his son's home because of his wife's death and the resulting loneliness, he realizes that he has lost his job as a boss and is struggling to regain his prestige by moving to a brothel.

title: O Aleijadinho
description: A brief piece on one of the greatest Brazilian artists of all time, Antônio Francisco Lisboa, the Aleijadinho. An important representant of the Baroque period in Brazil, Aleijadinho was famous for his artistic sculptures and figures made in soapstone, part of the many historical churches and other architetural monuments all located in Minas Gerais.

title: O Arrependimento é o Castigo
description: Karen é dona de casa e casada com Tom, um advogado rico. Enquanto trai o marido, sua casa pega fogo e a filha, Anna, de cinco anos, cai do andar de cima. A pequena é resgatada por Merry e levada por um caminhão dos bombeiros ao hospital. No caminho, o veículo colide com o carro de Karen. Sem saber que a menina ferida é sua filha, Karen exige desculpas e indenização — e atrasa a única chance de salvar Anna.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon?

title: Miss Q&A: Lucia, pagod nang magpanggap sa male pageants?
description:
Big pasabog ang naging announcement ni Bianca Gonzalez sa August 14 episode ng "It's Showtime." Kasama ang "Pinoy Big Brother" co-hosts na sina Gabbi Garcia at Kim Chiu, ibinalita ni Bianca ang muling pagbubukas ng Bahay ni Kuya sa pinakabagong "PBB Collab 3.0." 

To mark this new and exciting "PBB" era, nakisaya ang ilan sa mga ex-housemates. From Bahay Ni Kuya to the "It's Showtime" stage, muling nagsama-sama sa isang song and dance prod number sina “PBB Collab” ex-housemates AC Bonifacio, Klarisse De Guzman, Will Ashley, at Mika Salamanca, with Kabataang Pinoy Lella Ford, Joaquin Arce, Marco Masa, at Ashley Sarmiento na mula naman sa "PBB Collab 2.0."

Sa queendom ng talakan, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat. Pero sa araw na 'to, tatlong reyna ang nagharap-harap. Ibinuhos nina Sta. Lucia Joaquin Bordado, Miukie, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl ang wit at talak na di paaawat para korona ay sa kanila tumapat. 

Nakaka-reyna rin ang mga kuwento at inspirasyon na ibinahagi nila. Si Candidate 1, stop na sa pagpapanggap, kay from male pageants, Miss Q&A naman ang sinubukan upang maipakita ang totoong sarili. 

School teacher at dating principal naman si Candidate 2. Pero ano nga ba ang mga diskriminasyon na hinarap niya sa karera? At si Candidate 3, naghahanap ng kalinga ng ama. Nanawagan siya sa amang German, hoping na magkita sila soon sa unang pagkakataon.
Sina Miukie at CK ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang round. First time naman ni Bianca Gonzalez na umupo bilang hurado. 

Ang mga muscles nila ay kaflex-flex! Mag-work out din kaya ang swerte para sa mga gym instructors ng Metro Manila.

Si player Nad ang patunay na palaging may second chance ang taong determinadong mapaganda ang buhay. Ang dating number one sa inuman, gym na ang paboritong tambayan. 

Katulad sa real life, nabigyan din si Nad ng second chance sa laro. Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ngg players, bumunot ng isang sasalang sa jackpot round, at pangalan ni Nad ang nabunot.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, may kakaibang dictionary!
description:
Mula sa iconic na “Jumbo Hotdog” at “Sana Mama” na minsang nagpaindak sa buong nation, nagbabalik to flex their muscles and new single ang grupong Masculados. Grateful ang grupo na makabalik at mabigyan ng pagkakataong ipagpatuloy ang kanilang musika.

Hindi lang ganda ang puhunan, dapat may wit na panlaban. Dahil bawat tanong, kailangang may sagot na papalakpakan ng buong bayan. Kaya naghanda ng matitinding linyahan ang mga Miss Q and A candidates na nagharapan.

Ready magbigay ng tutorial sa ganda at talino ang online tutor na si Precious Alden Ganaden, habang mula pageant coaching ay siya naman ngayon ang sasabak sa sariling laban, si MJ Apin Salada. Naaliw naman ang Madlang People, pati na si Vice Ganda, sa kakaibang dictionary ni Ivanach.

Sa second round na Wit Lang, sina MJ at Ivanach ang nagharap. Sinubok si Ivanach sa tanong na, “Kung lechon ka, mao-offend ka ba kung balat lang ang habol sa ’yo samantalang full package ka naman?” Si MJ naman, napaisip kunngmagtatampo ba ang king cobra kung hindi siya ang king of the jungle.

Ayusin ang display at siguraduhing kumpleto ang stocks at siguruhing available ang swerte. Mula sa pag-aasikaso ng mga produktong mabenta, saglit munang iniwan ng mga merchandisers mula NCR ang kanilang puwesto para subukang i-checkout ang POT money sa “Laro Laro Pick."

Kinilala ng hosts si player Frank, ang loving hubby and addy na baon sa utang. Kaya naman si Tyang Amy Perez, to the rescue bitbit ang payo niyang wais. Love life naman ang usapan nang kanilang lapitan si pplayer Yong, na dinamayan ng hosts matapos malamang hiwalay na sila ng kanyang girlfriend.

Kay Frank talaga napunta ang swerte dahil siya ang umabot sa Jackpot Round! Pero imbes na isugal ang lahat para sa ₱450,000 POT, pinili niyang tanggapin ang ₱35,000 Li-Pot offer para may siguradong maipambayad sa kanyang maraming utang.

description:
Napahugot ang madlang people sa pagbisita ng bandang Mayonnaise at sa kanilang performance ng “Bakit, Pt. 2.” 'Nag-spread' din sila ng good vibes nang makisabay sa trending “Meme” dance challenge!

Ang kandidata na mabagal sa pindutan at waley sa talakan, siya naman ang uuwing luhaan. Buti na lang palaban at ginalingan nina "Miss Q and A" JC Ibale, Anxji Rose, at Bon Joey Trinidad.

Habang kinikilala ng hosts ang tatlong ladies, pagandahan din sila ng mga joke entries. Ang starting lineup ay sina Vice Ganda, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro, pero 'di nagtagal, si Vhong ang unang napatalsik dahil sa joke niyang not-so matinik. First substitution of the day!

Chance na rin ito ng ibang hosts na sumabak sa "Miss Q and A." Maya-maya pa, nasubok naman ang husay ni Teddy Corpuz. Pero hindi pa man nagsisimula ang banter, parang may "issue" detected agad. Biro ni Meme, huwag gumigilid-glid si Teddy dahil baka magreklamo ito sa blocking, tapos ang netizens umariba na naman sa bashing.

Back to the pageant, unang pumaslak sa next round si JC, habang sina Anxji at Bon Joey ay nagbangayan tungkol sa "eulogy." Kaloka, mga teh! Pero pagkatapos ng mahabang diskusyon, si Bon Joey ang umabante sa Wit Lang at tumalak sa harap ng buong nation.

Kapag swerte ang bumagsak, huwag manghihina. Baka jackpot ang naghihintay sa players mula Marikina! POT money kaya ay maiuuwi nila?

Mukhang may dalang swerte talaga kapag ikaw ang first interviewee, dahil madalas, sa jackpot round, sila rin ang umaabante. Araw talaga ito ni Emon dahil siya ang naglaro sa POT o Li-POT round.

title: NAHILO! Pokwang, NILARO ang comment sa Miss Q&A
description:
Kilig harana ang hatid ng bisitang si John Rex Baculfo, who shared that it feels nice to be back onstage singing his new single, na tungkol sa mga taong patuloy na umaasa. Napahugot si John Rex doon ah!

Sa tanungan at talakan, bawal ang sabaw at lutang. Dapat mabilis mag-isip at mas okay rin 'yung chukchak na may halong tapang. Tatlong reyna muli ang sumabak sa "Miss Q and " daily round sa "It's Showtime."

Maraming baon sina Lianne Marie Etorma, Jerica Arboleda Ibarra, at Reign Manzano Gaboy pagdating sa kalokohan, syempre pati na rin sa talakan. Si Lianne nga ba ang totoong panganay ni Ogie Alcasid? "Kalokalike" ang hatol ng mga nagmamasid.

Si Jerica naman, pitong taon lamang nang magsimulang sumabak sa pageants. Kahit madalas talo, bakit hindi siya nagasasawang sumali sa mga patimpalak na ganito? At matapos malotlot ni Lianne, si Ogie nagbigay ng words of wisdom.

Sa "Wit Lang" round, nabunot ni Reign ang tanong na, “Sino ang anak ng mag-asawang sampal?” Laro rin ang tanong na napili ni Jerica, “Sa iyong palagay, mabaho ba ang hininga ng kaututang dila?”

Mapapaisip ka talaga sabay matatawa katulad ng na-feel nina hurado Pokwang, River Joseph, at Nicole Cordoves. Si 'Mamang' Pokwang, nilaro rin ang comment. Nahilo raw siya sa sagot ng isang kandidata, na sa sobrang lalim parang pwede nang hukayin.

Mga taga-Dela Paz, Antipolo, Rizal ang sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Parang rollercoaster ang kuwentuhan ng hosts kay player Lizel, na naging 'judge' pa sa isang impromptu papogian portion ng male hosts. Sino nga ba ang pinakagwapo? Nanguna sa ranking si Vhong Navarro, at si Ogie Alcasid naman ang inilagay sa dulo, kaya siya ang naging target ng panunukso.

Umabante sa jackpot round si player Monique, isang volunteer tanod sa kanilang barangay. Para siguradong may maiuuwi, dedma na si Monique sa P400,000 POT question at tinanggap ang P30,000 offer na malaking tulong na raw para sa needs ng pamilya.

title: River Joseph, hurado sa Miss Q and A!
description:
Good music ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, at Yannie Paul Basical. Pinagsama-sama ng limang powerhouse singers ang kanilang winning voices sa isang performance na perfect pampagaan ng mood bago sumabak sa weekend.

Nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" for a second chance sa Miss Q&A Resbakulawan sina Nadie Marie Fernandez, Miukie, at Belle Tinkerbell.

Tumatak si Nadie dahil sa tawa niyang kakaiba. Natandaan naman ni Vice Ganda ang unique na pangalang Miukie. But arguably the most remarkable of the three, si Belle, na binansagang 'Sofronia Vasquez' ni Meme. Siya 'yung kandidata na sa pagpindot ay nahuli pero sa talak ang daming sinasabi. Hirit niya, baka pinabalik siya dahil awa, pero itinanggi 'yan ni Vice Ganda. Sabi ni Meme, nabitin daw ang lahat sa talak noon ni Belle.

Pagkatapos ng Wit Lang, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Belle ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan mayroon silang tatlumpung segundo para sagutin ang tanong tungkol sa epekto ng pagkawala ng taong minamahal. Naging emosyonal si Nadie na inalala ang nawalang pamangkin, at galing din sa puso ang chukchak ni Belle na nagpahayag naman ng pagmamahal sa ina.

Dumayo sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang mga taga-Barangay Batis, San Juan City. Hindi pasyal ang sadya nila kundi mga challenges na pwedeng magdala sa kanila sa POT money.

Nakipagkuwentuhan ng hosts sa tricycle driver na si Viomar. Pero ang nagpakitang-gilas, walang iba kundi si Amy Perez, na daig pa ang tricycle driver sa kanyang knowledge. Ang mga pasikot-sikot na kalye sa Maynila, kabisado ni Tyang!

Si Edwin ang nakarating sa Jackpot Round. Bago pa man ihain ang Li-Pot offer, buo na ang loob niyang ilaban ang ₱400,000 POT question anuman ang ialok sa kanya.

title: Kandidata, pinulikat sa gitna ng Miss Q&A weekly finals
description:
Limang ‘accla’ na maririkit ang nagpasiklaban ng wit sa isa na namang masayang weekly finals ng Miss Q and A sa "It's Showtime."

Bago ang talakan, enjoy muna ang mga Miss Q and A weekly finlists at ang mga hosts na sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario sa kuwentuhan. Dahil Sabado at bihis na bihis ang mga 'fersons,' hindi maiwasan ang OOTD puksaan. Si Vice, napagtulungan dahil sa suot niyang shorts na basketball uniform daw, at boots na pampulis kalawakan. Si Jhong naman, very Gen Z at trendy sa buhok na kulot. Hirit naman ni Vice sa suot na nude vest ni Vhong, parang action star ang pormahan pero may Barbie arms.

Samantala, na-miss ni Vice Ganda ang pagkikita nila ni candidate Bong Bong, na lumaban noong August 13. Papayag nga ba si Meme na rumesbak si Bong Bong?

Idol talaga sa chukchakan sina Miss Q&A weekly finalists Jurexa Caparino, Nadimunyo Lustre, Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Rocky Cueva, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl.

Si Nadimunyo ang unang naligwak sa kompetisyon, samantalang ang apat ay umabante sa Wit Lang. Mula naman sa apat, ang Top 2 na sina Rocky at CK ang nag-face off sa final round, Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Ano ang mas mahirap—tanggapin ang ayaw mo o tanggihan ang gusto mo?"

Mahusay sila sa time management habang pinagsasabay ang sports at academics. Pero sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, maging champion kaya ang mga student athletes?

Si player Angel-El, may pag-demo ng karate moves. Ingat lang baka matamaan ng sumisipa niyang galawan! Sumisipa rin ang good vibes sa aktingan round na You Gotta Lyric. Ito na ba 'yung DaCkie in an LQ scene? Ay, sina Ryan Bang at Teddy Corpuz pala!

Bigo ang mga natirang players na mka-survive hanggang dulo, kaya bumunot ng isang lucky manlalaro. Parang buzzer beater shot, biglang nabuhay ang kapalaran ni Jayvee. Hindi man niya nasagot ang POT question, hanga pa rin si Vice Ganda sa fighting spirit ni Jayvee at sa sipag ng mga kabataang atleta, kaya naisip niyang regaluhan ng extra P1,000 ang bawat players.

title: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENT, nangakong babalik sa Miss Q&A
description:
Mga pusong dati’y takot magpakatotoo, ngayon ay rumarampa nang taas-noo. Huwag nang matakot at mangamba, mga accla! Be proud at huwag magtago sa dilim! Slay, mga bading!

Ngayong Pride Month, officially nag-come-BEK na ang paboritong talakan segment ng Madlang People at sangkabadingan. Pinangunahan ni Vice Ganda ang pagbubukas ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A" sa isang makulay na production number with the proud gay members of the LGBT community at si Anne Patricia Lorenzo, ang may-ari ng korona sa previous season na "Miss Q and A: Kween of the Multibeks."

Ang unang batch ng contestants na sumalang sa talakan ay ang ex-campus journalist na si Miss Jawo, ang ‘lutang’ call center agent na si Princess Elizabeth, at Erin Rio na isang call center agent din. Sa Round 1, nag-unahan ang tatlong beki na sagutin ang tanong gamit ang dalawang phrases. Ang first two contestants to earn a point lang ang aabante sa next round. 'Ligwak' si Princess. Pero kahit nagkatotoo ang pabirong prediction ni Meme Vice na hindi ito mananalo, positibo pa rin ang pananaw ni Princess sa kanyang 'Talak ng Lotlot' farewell speech.

Sa Round 2, bumunot ang natitirang contestantsng tig-isang tanong. Mas pinusuan nina Karylle, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang sagot ni Miss Jawo judges sa araw na 'to.

Best in kulitan ang mga taga-Bignay, Valenzuela! Good vibes ang bigay nila sa Laro laro Pick game arena. Hindi pwedeng trip-trip lang ang performance sa mga games! Dapat galingan para sa chance na makapaglaro sa jackpot round.

Si Edzel ang umabante sa final game. Pero bakit si Ogie Alcasid ang teary-eyed nang mapag-usapan ang asawang si Regine Velasquez? At tulad ni Ogie, iiyak din ba si Edzel sa kanyang mapipili?

title: Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

Sa Act-Song, si Vhong Navarro umeksena kina Darren Espanto at Cianne Dominguez. Si Ryan Bang naman, “binasted” si Cianne? Sa dulo ng laro, si Mckoy ang panalo at umabante sa jackpot round.

title: Chyort s portfelem
description: The journalist of the regional newspaper "Raduga" Mikhail Makarov, a fearless author of accusatory fieletons, a principled fighter against slovenliness and mismanagement, sharply criticizes the editor-in-chief, who does not let his scandalous articles go to press or cut off his scandalous articles due to lack of facts. Once buying potatoes at the market, Makarov meets a young saleswoman who offers him to collect critical material on her collective farm for the next fieleton. Having gone on an editorial trip and convinced on the spot in all the facts about the rotting record crop of potatoes, the enthusiastic journalist prepares a devastating article. But, unexpectedly finding himself for a short time in the place of his boss, and faced with the real bureaucracy in the planned economy of various departments, Makarov changes his mind.

title: S Is for Sexy
description: Seven Sexy and Smart Short Gay Films: Serene Hunter (France) Set in Paris, the 'hunter' of the title is a 30-something gay male who has a string of one-night stands. Content being free and unfettered by relationships, he happily moves from encounter to encounter. He then surprises himself by becoming involved in a more substantial relationship...but can the hunter within him be tamed? An honest portrayal, with some explicit action. Solace (US) This film shows an older and younger man who meet on the internet, and seem to get along well, until the older man tells about his boyfriend and it shatters younger man's dreams. Scarred (UK) An early 20s male has a significant scar on his face from a knife wound - and is fed up of the unwanted attention that it attracts. Will he find someone who can see past the scar? The answer may lie with an older, middle-aged architect, who seems to be the one person to whom the scar is invisible. Signage (US) Middle age can be hidden somewhat with makeup and hair coloring, which encourages two best friends to plan a night out at a bar that caters to young men half their age. One makes a strong connection with a young deaf guy, only to find out that there is more than one type of obstacle involved. Mr_Right_22 (Germany) First-date jitters in the age of internet dating but a kind waiter calms his fears and offers some encouragement to be open to life's opportunities. Cute. 41 Seconds (Germany) Two masculine friends take about "41 Seconds" to compare notes on one of their dates, in which his girlfriend compared their respective skills as a kisser. Only 4 minutes, but cute. Shahram and Abbas (Netherlands) Two Iranian refugees, a young student activist and an older journalist, who want to see political asylum in the Netherlands. Believing they have a better chance of being granted such if they claim to be a persecuted homosexual couple, they begin a charade that leads to complications they never imagined, especially when the younger Shahram falls for a woman also awaiting asylum. Powerful and positive depiction of a very sad and serious situation.

title: Mittal V/S Mittal
description: Girls have dreams - dreams of a fairytale romance, of prince charming sweeping them off their feet, a dream wedding and living happily ever-after. Mitali, a successful model, also had dreams... Then one day she met Karan, the Mittal scion, the heir to one of the richest families in the country. Mitali 's simple, middle-class upbringing is in complete contrast to Karan's super-brat lifestyle. But Karan was smitten by Mitali. Accustomed to getting what he wants in life, Karan landed up at Mitali's home with his parents with a marriage proposal. Delighted at their daughter's luck, Mitali's family approved of the match. And Mitali entered Karan's home and life as his newly-wedded bride. It was not long before Mitali's dreams turned into her worst nightmare. Her mother-in-law detested her and created misunderstandings between Karan and her. Karan turned out to be a puppet in his mother's hands and her father-in-law is a helpless, mute spectator. Karan has a certain pattern of dealing with women and wanted to subdue Mitali's independent streak. He who appeared to be a loving husband was in fact a violent monster at night within the privacy of their bedroom.Unable to bear the humiliation and pain after she resisted his advances and is raped by him,Mitali decided to take charge of her life. She decided to fight back.Mitali walked out of her in-laws home, hired a lawyer and filed a case against her husband. Karan retaliated by hiring the best lawyer money can buy to fight on his behalf. Mittal Vs Mittal is about to he heard in court. It is a case on file that fights for the rights of women like Mitali who are subjugated to domestic violence and inhuman treatment at the hands of husband and in-laws. It is a case that will empower women to fight for their pride, respect and their very right to live with dignity. It is Mitali Mittal versus Karan Mittal...

title: Making Sh*t Up
description:
This film takes you behind the scenes in the timeline of a dynamic and ambitious young conceptual artist, from his "Clearance Sale" of a lifetime's work at ArtLA, to weeks of dispensing therapy at the Whitney Biennial, to a near-death injury on Miami's Biscayne Boulevard and the mindset that followed. Includes detailed on-site action at art installations and performances, with spirited opinions from celebrated artists and art world professionals about measuring the success and value of conceptual art.

The film is narrated with spirited, candid commentary by important artists and art professionals such as legendary conceptual / performance artists Marina Abramovic and Vito Acconci on the highs and lows of a conceptual art world with uniquely difficult career choices, by famed New York Magazine Senior Art Critic Jerry Saltz on what is and isn't conceptual art and how Rodriguez measures up, author Steven Henry Madoff about Rodriguez service aesthetics achievements, and celebrated New York art blogger C-Monster.net, who experienced the artist, face- to-face and alone, locked inside his therapy cube.

title: Clocking the T
description: Dave is a professional internet troll who lies for a living. Candace is in human resources at a blood lab with a bipolar boss. They meet online and circle the airport of their relationship, refusing to land.

title: Ap' t' alonia, sta salonia
description: A singer lands a job at a trendy nightclub. After her rapid rise to stardom, she meets an idealist classical musician; but, they are too proud to admit their deeper feelings for each other. Will they bury the hatchet for love's sake?

title: Podvodnaya lodka T-9
description: The Great Patriotic War. The Soviet submarine T-9, having passed through the minefields of the North Sea, penetrates into the enemy port. Sailors sink enemy transport ships, but soon find out that they were late - enemy troops and weapons have already been unloaded and sent to the front. Captain Kostrov finds himself in a situation where the combat mission is almost impossible, but he must complete it - for him it is a matter of honor or dishonor.

title: Loyal-T
description: Loyal-T is a drama depicting the life of Travis Jones, and Malia Parker, best friends since childhood. The two faced different challenges in life, but their decisions brought them to the path of selling drugs.

title: Blood, Sweat & T-Shirts
description: Six Western, relatively spoiled English youths visits underdeveloped places overseas where some of the luxury goods or crucial components are produced they take for granted. They not only visit, but experience the harsh life of Third World laborers often backbreaking, dangerous, poorly paid jobs.

title: The Big T.N.T. Show
description: Live performances by some of the top rock-and-roll acts of the mid 60s. Includes Ray Charles, The Byrds, Joan Baez, Ike and Tina Turner, Donovan, The Lovin' Spoonful, and several more.

description: The eccentric but brilliant criminology professor Jasper Teerlinck is an advisor to the Belgian federal police in Antwerp. Although a valuable contributor, he drives everyone nuts because of his strange behavior.

title: T
description: Bishnu was often beaten up by father for his girlish behavior. His unusual behavior was the subject of fun for his classmates. Will he ever get employed and have equal rights?

title: Don't Run

title: W;t
description: A renowned professor is forced to reassess her life when she is diagnosed with terminal ovarian cancer.

title: S.C.O.T.T the Movie
description: Social, Connective, Opinionated, Talking, Technology, or S.C.O.T.T for short is an android from outer space. Along with his fellow aliens he comes down to earth to serve his purpose as a helpful little robot. However, all is not what it seems, this little S.C.O.T.T has a mind over his own and a sense of adventure to go with it. Will S.C.O.T.T serve his purpose or will he land himself into trouble.

title: T-Bag Bounces Back
description: T. Bag has regained her powers and calls her former servant, Thomas, into a storybook and makes him serve her tea again as 'T.Shirt'. title: White T
description: Herbert and Henry (Jerod and Jamal Mixon) are twin brothers who dream of becoming the biggest rap stars in the game. Their chance at superstardom comes after they buy a T-shirt with a winning golden tag that allows them to perform Real Deal, the most legendary rapper in the world. However, Kevin, a Jewish kid their same size with dreams of singing and blinging manages to steal the prized Whit T and has his own plans to perform at the concert. With help from a gypsy, a goat, and cast of characters as big as Herbert and Henry's appetites, White T is a feel-good urban adventure reminiscent of "Dude. Where's My Car?", "Harold and Kumar Go to White Castle", and "Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory."

title: The T
description: Jo, a white trans woman craving an increasingly elusive intimacy, Carter, a queer Black man at odds with his conservative upbringing, and Emerie, a Latina trans woman stuck in an incompatible relationship, all converge from different parts of Chicago for a magical New Year's Eve night. As hangovers fade, and the three friends face awkward hook-ups, nervous dates, and the unlikely pursuit of lasting love, at least they have each other.

title: Emp4t

title: Terrifying T-Rex

title: Don't Jump

title: Don't Be Shy

title: 't Wordt toch niks

title: Don't

title: Duh u mocvari
description: A brother and sister, Miron and Melita, go to visit their friend Zoltan (Liptus) in Kopacevo for winter vacation. The local residents and hunting lodge members there are involved in a big campaign to help the wild animals from the reserve to survive the winter. The same night Miron and Melita arrive, a boy named Halasz is found half-frozen at the edge of the swamp where, he raves, that he was attacked by a white ghost on one of the islands of the swamp. From then on, he can no longer talk. The old woman Etelka reveals the secret that the ghost had been first seen long ago and that you cannot go to the island because the ghost wreaks vengeance on anyone stepping onto the island. Fear takes hold in the place. The hunters, with Vucevic, Kovacevic and Levay taking the lead, begin an investigation however neither they nor the doctors can help Halasz. Therefore Miron, Liptus and Melita decide to find the ghost and offer to carry it off the island to the shore in exchange making their friend well again. However, the ghost shoots and wounds the hunter Levay proving that the ghost is much more dangerous than was previously thought.

title: Mee Aani U
description: At every corner there is a love story blooming. Most have usual problems but few are exceptional. Mee Ani U is one of them. Abhishek and Ira meet through Facebook (Social Networking).Initially it's a game of hide and seek with their fake facebook profiles. After a while it moves from internet to mobile, Chatting to Texting sharing each and every information with harmless flirting. With day-to-day sharing and caring, lovely Ira starts getting involved with the playful Abhishek.But this is not why our story is exceptional. Even though over internet they are in love but in person they hate each other. Will Abhishek change for his love? Will Abhishek and Ira realize their love for each other? And if they do how will they realize? A Fun, Twisted love story with a Fresh treatment. Youth oriented, full on dhamaal Masala is...''Mee Ani U''

title: Twarza w twarz
description: Face can be altered the same as the identity. However, past remains unchanged. Sometimes you try to get away from it but sooner or later you will have to face what happened in order to rebuild your life. Victor 'Dragonfly' is a highly skilled thief. He is shot in face during a police action in which a policeman dies. Dragonfly becomes prime suspect. Because of being chased by the police Victor escapes abroad. Thanks to his friend, Baker, he lands in Swiss plastic surgery clinic run by professor Michalski. His daughter Martha, a talented plastic surgeon, undertakes Dragonfly's face surgery. During two years she conducts series of operations to change Victor's face. Martha is not aware of her patient's past and she falls in love with him reciprocally. Dragonfly wants to start a new, honest life with beloved woman. However, their plans are ruined by Victor's past. He returns to Poland in order to clear himself of a charge of murder. Martha is familiarized with the criminal past of the man she loves. She starts doubting in his innocence...

title: Abnaa w Qatalah
description: When Shaikhon marries Dalal, a belly dancer. He steals Dalal's money to buy the club where she works. Dalal gets back at him and reports him to the police who have him imprisoned. He comes out of prison full of vengeance.

title: Dr. W
description: Now you are in the domains of magic and fantasy! You are surrounded by the wonders of life and you can ask as many questions as you want! You're on the Dr. W Show! Are you afraid? Are you tired? Alone? Bored??? Have you lost your faith??? Dr. W is here and has something for everyone; No matter if you are small as a microbe or as big as the universe, fast as lightning or slow as evolution, you will get something amazing! Really surprising! So try not to get too excited, try not to laugh and shout very loudly, because what you are about to see is something that you have not seen before. Welcome ... this is the Dr. W Show! Dr. Woody Bonepecker, aka Dr. W, is a delirious doctor who is always looking for the truth of the natural facts of everyday life. He is the presenter of a TV program, and in each episode he will explain to the audience different phenomena in his particular, ironic and hilarious style. Dr. W is really stubborn, he is not afraid of anything and will do anything necessary to get to the bottom of things. In his show, Dr. W uses all kinds of resources to present and explain the topics. Not only does he perform crazy experiments as a good scientist, he also appeals to the most absurd humor as if he were a clown, or to the most fantastic magic as if he were a magician. Dr. W also has the help of special guests in many episodes, as well as an enormous variety of characters that appear to help him in the development of each theme. Likewise, the live audience has a fundamental role, as it reacts to the explanations of Dr. W at all times.

title: Meraty w Zawgaty
description: In a satirical comic framework, the movie revolves around a young man (Ramez Galal) who marries a girl interested in women's rights and faces the challenges that hinder her in achieving her dreams, but this means she isn't spending enough time with his husband, and her lack of interest in her marriage leads him to marry another woman. This plunges him into numerous troubles and ironies that turn his life into Hell.

description: Fire changes the life of a dull lonely bank cashier into a hero. He gets the woman he has always dreamt of. But, considering his modesty and peculiarity, will they really be happy together?

title: W Teqabel Habib

title: W domu
description: Spring 2020, Poland. 16 filmmakers create 14 short films about unexpected experience of isolation caused by pandemic.

title: The Great W
description: In a post-apocalyptic setting, comic book fanatic Winston sets out to save a captured Deadmen operative named Emily. His spontaneous decision out of boredom gets him involved in the middle of a faction rivalry.

title: Aard W Talab
description: "The series follows intersecting lives under pressure, led by Heba, a schoolteacher who struggles to support her family, care for her brother with disabilities, and save her sick mother."

title: W pustyni i w puszczy
description: Fourteen year old Polish boy Stas Tarkowski and eight year old Nel Rawlison from England are kidnapped as the hostages by Arabic fanatics and taken to their religion leader. Then they manage to escape and try to return to their fathers. Children have a lot of dangerous adventures, meet two Black kids; Kali and Mea, who also help them, make a friendship with an elephant and help one Black's tribe. Finally they manage to return. Based on great novel, the same title by Nobel receiver (for all his literary output) Henryk Sienkiewicz.

title: S.W.A.T.
description: Follows the life of Sergeant Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson born and raised in Los Angeles, as he faces conflict between his loyalty to the streets and his colleagues in the force, especially after being assigned to lead the S.W.A.T. unit, which is the last stop to combat crime in LA.

title: Cocolos y Rockeros
description: This documentary examines the musical tastes of Puerto Rico's youth. The terms "cocolos" refers to those who prefer "salsa" music, and "rockeros" to those who prefer "rock" music. title: Pojdi z mano
description: In search of the best photo for the school competition, four teenagers head to remote hills. The competition for awards turns into a struggle for survival. Manc, who leads the group to remote but scenic countryside, where he spent his childhood with his grandpa, had been accused of stealing a phone and consequently might be expelled from school. Schoolmates Mina, Oto and Spurc join him on this trip. Mina, who is spoiled, stubborn city girl, breaks first in this foreign environment, but luckily by her side always stands Oto, rational boy who is in love with her. In this untouched nature which is such an unknown world to them also Spurc, who was golden-spoon-fed all his life, turns into a cowardish spoiled-child, and at the end Manc is again the one who safely guides them back home. A story about growing up, love, friendship and heroism. The warm but suspenseful and occasionally spine-chilling film focuses on what happens in the today's world when technology stops working and the 'primal' human instincts come to light.

title: Z-Squad

title: Drug Z
description: After her husband's tragic murder, a recently widowed woman seeks solace in Las Vegas, determined to make a fresh start for herself and her daughter. Unbeknownst to her, among her late husband's belongings lies a powerful drug formula, which unwittingly entangles her with a mysterious neighbor who harbors hidden knowledge. Soon, a small-time drug dealer and thief seize the opportunity to steal the potent drug, plotting to distribute it at a party. As chaos erupts at the ill-fated gathering, the drug dealer manages to escape the premises infested with zombies, leaving behind a trail of death and devastation. Now, the question remains: Is this the beginning of a Zombie Apocalypse, or could an even greater plan be set into motion?

title: Zero Hour
description: Set in the isolated trenches of W.W.I, Zero Hour is the tale of a young British Officer confronted with shocking discoveries about his newly assigned Company in Northern France. In his quest for duty and honor, Lieutenant Oliver Enfield decides to set things right by taking matters into his own hands. On the eve of a major offensive, Lieutenant Enfield embarks on an unauthorized reconnaissance mission. Instead of finding answers he undergoes a harsh but fantastical journey of transformation, which ultimately leads him to question his own sanity and purpose. At a turning point in his existence he must answer the question-Does an officer's duty to country demand blind loyalty? Or can it be an opportunity to save his men from one of the most futile advances of the First World War.

description: Izu Ojukwu's Power of 1 is now available on Amazon Prime Video for viewers in the US and UK. The political thriller, which is partly inspired by 2 Baba's shelved 2017 protests stars Alexx Ekubo in the lead role of Justin Aba, a socially conscious afro-pop artiste with a large following. When Justin Aba decides to use his influence to stage a protest against the policies of the incumbent government, he is drawn into a game of politics he didn't bargain for. This film shows the twists, turns, and intrigue of a proposed protest march called by an influential pop artiste, that shook the socio-political landscape of Nigeria to its very foundation. Nerves are stretched to breaking point as the decision to take ownership and execute the protest throws up intriguing reactions from security operatives, political players, hustlers and opportunists Power of 1 stars Ramsey Nouah, Anne Idibia, Jide Kosoko and Michelle Dede. The film was released in cinemas nationwide last December and has played in theatres in the UK and US.
